gizmo.title: Doodle board
gizmo.description: Draw a picture, mark up an image with feedback, or collect a signature.

configure.title: Use
configure.description: Drawing for pictures, Feedback to mark up a submission, Signature for a signature pad.

configure.title: Drawing
configure.description: Opens the editor. Pen, highlighter, boxes, circles, arrows and text.

configure.title: Background image
configure.description: A submission to give feedback on, or a picture to draw over.

configure.title: Alt text
configure.description: Describe the drawing and what it marks for people who cannot see it.

advanced.title: Visitors can draw
advanced.description: Shows the editor on the published page so visitors can draw and download their picture. Nothing they draw is saved to the site.

advanced.title: Width
advanced.description: Surface width in pixels when there is no background image.

advanced.title: Height
advanced.description: Surface height in pixels when there is no background image.

documentation.purpose: Lets authors and visitors draw, mark up a submission with feedback, or sign, in one element.
